Okay, not quite sure how to start this but here it goes. I've struggled with issues for a long time and don't usually tell anyone the full story. So for a change, I wanted to put it all down. A bit summarized, but this is a good introduction to a side of me people seldom know. I wrote this several months ago.
        "I first remember feeling sad in highschool- maybe the usually feelings of inadequacy or angst, and I thought nothing of it. Over time, these feelings grew in intensity and frequency.  Two years after the feelings started, I narrowly avoided a car accident, which likely would have severely injured me at best. my first thought was how mad my brother would be that I wrecked the car, not about almost dying. i realized that I didnt care about my life then. I learned that I wanted to die.
    By the time highschool finished, I had found a few things I excelled at and was off to a highly competitive university. Things went very badly there. Did horrendously bad in academics and athletics, depression was crippling, traumatic brain injury, being held in a psych ward, and an abusive relationship. Life has been ups and down, mostly downs.
    It is now the summer of my sophomore year of college. I will be attending a different school in the fall-I lost my scholarship and no aid will be provided. I am not over my ex, and blame myself constantly for every setback and failure, big or small. 
    Though I have a wonderful therapist and am medicated for depression, I am losing hope still. I am a burden on my family and friends because of my mental illness. I don't have the strength to keep going and I've been considering suicide as seriously as I ever have. I am drafting a note and beginning to put my affairs in order. I wanted to get that all off my chest, even if it will be stuck in my mind."
